title: RobotState
description: Retained on agri/v1/{robot_id}/state. The broker republishes it to every new subscriber, so a browser opening the store sees the robot's liveness immediately. The Last Will and Testament is a copy of this payload with online=false and reason='lwt', which the broker publishes if the robot's connection drops without a clean disconnect.

online.description: False in the LWT and in a clean shutdown notice.

estop_engaged.description: Latched on the robot. Clears only on an explicit operator reset.

config_version.description: Version of the configuration the robot is currently running.
